Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers and the caching examples. We want to run a short pilot (4 weeks, ~100k tokens/day peak) to validate throughput and compute economics. Before we kick off, procurement asked for a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that contains milestones, acceptance criteria, and any commercial credits / conversion terms so they can sign off.

High level asks from Acme:
- Pilot start: target Aug 24
- Success criteria: <5% error rate on our prompt set, sustained 80 req/s with 50 token avg latency <300ms
- Post-pilot: pricing for committed throughput and conversion path for production

Can you send a draft MAP + what credits you can extend for this pilot? Also need an estimate for committed pricing if we convert after pilot.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Li
Director, Applied AI — Acme Corp

Sarah — great to hear, and glad the demo landed. I attached a draft MAP and a simple SOW that maps milestones to acceptance criteria and a credit ladder for conversion. High-level proposal below; detailed items are in the PDF/SOW.

Proposal (pilot -> conversion):
- Pilot: 4 weeks, free trial credit: $30k applied to usage (covers peak + buffer).
- Milestone 1 (week 1): Integration + baseline test (pass = observed throughput 60% of target)..
- Milestone 2 (week 2–3): Load stress and KV/prefix cache tuning (pass = sustained 80 req/s for 10 minutes).
- Milestone 3 (end of pilot): Quality & latency acceptance (pass = <5% error and median token latency <300ms).
- Conversion offer: 12-month reserved capacity with stepped commit ladder — start at 50k tokens/day commit, scale to 200k tokens/day in month 4. Pricing tiers and discounts in SOW.

Commercial concessions:
- If all milestones pass, we apply $20k conversion credit toward first invoice (in addition to pilot credit).
- If Acme signs within 30 days of pilot end, additional 10% one-time onboarding discount.
- If milestones are missed due to missing customer data or infra constraints, credits are prorated.

I copied Camila and Aditya to align on technical SLAs and commercial ops. Attaching: MAP_Draft_Acme_v2.pdf, SOW_ACME_Q3.xlsx.

Next steps: review the draft MAP, confirm pilot start date (Aug 24), and we'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with infra on Aug 24.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Vivek — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarity. A few procurement questions before we formalize the MAP:
1) Can you break out the $30k pilot credit into usage vs. engineering support (we need to know cash exposure if we hit heavy engineering time).
2) What happens to live inference data post-pilot (retention, deletion, and audit logs)? We need SOC2 evidence for that window.
3) If we exceed the pilot token buffer, will additional usage be billed at list or do you cap charges?

Also, our legal asked whether the conversion credit ($20k) requires a minimum commit or is unconditional on signing.

Thanks — if you can answer these in-line in the MAP PDF or here that would help speed procurement.

Tom
Head of Platform Engineering — Acme Corp
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Henderson <tom.h@acme.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18 09:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation & MAP discussion

Tom — answering inline:

1) Pilot credit split: we propose $22k usage credit, $8k for engineering/support hours (on-call + 3 onboarding sessions). Support hours are to cover integration and tuning; additional support is available at our standard PS rates (listed in SOW).

2) Data retention: by default hosted logs & traces for pilot retained for 90 days. We can arrange 30-day deletion window if you need shorter retention; we’ll provide SOC 2 Type II evidence and an export of audit logs as part of the MAP appendix. See section 4 of the MAP PDF.

3) Overages: we will cap billed usage during pilot to list rates but will notify and put any overage onto a hold pending mutual review. If you want a hard cap, we can set automated rate-limiting at threshold and escalate.

Conversion credit terms: $20k conversion credit requires a signed 12-month reserved capacity agreement at a minimum commit of 50k tokens/day. If you sign within 30 days of pilot end we apply the credit to the first invoice.

If that works, we can insert the exact language into the MAP and produce a one-click DocuSign link for the SOW/Reserve contract.

Camila
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — sounds like we're aligned on the structure. Quick summary and action items (final before kickoff):

Summary of agreed commercial terms:
- Pilot window: Aug 24 — Sep 20 (4 weeks).
- Pilot credits: $30k total (split $22k usage / $8k support).
- Automated hard cap: set to 125% of forecasted daily tokens; overage held and requires mutual review.
- Acceptance: pass all three milestones -> $20k conversion credit toward first reserved invoice.
- Conversion offer: 12-month reserve, starting 50k tokens/day commit, step-up to 200k tokens/day per the ladder in SOW; 10% onboarding discount if signed within 30 days of pilot end.
- Data & compliance: logs retained 90 days default; SOC2 artifacts included in appendix; option for 30-day deletion request.

Action items:
- Acme: confirm pilot start (reply here by EOD Aug 22).
- Redwood (Camila/Aditya): schedule kickoff infra call for Aug 24, push final DocuSign link for SOW + reserve contract.
- Vivek: draft short email for procurement with one-page MAP and cost breakout (I’ll send this morning).

If we get the go-ahead from you today/tomorrow we’ll lock resources. Thanks — excited to get started.
